title: Is creature_raw.frequency a REVERSIBLE lever on cavern spawning? Addendum 52 suppressed two species and could not show their return — neither came back in 24,165 ticks, though other species did, which is inconclusive rather than negative. Here seven common cavern species are suppressed together for the first half of a season and restored at the half-way tick, against a control never touched. The tool is DISABLED throughout: this measures the game, not the roster. Cavern counts exclude the magma sea and the underworld by cave depth, which addendum 51 showed were being miscounted as cavern wildlife.
fork: Is frequency the reversible lever the cavern layer can be managed with, or does zeroing it latch.

predictions.expects: near-zero arrivals of the seven before tick 67200, a clear return after, while the control has them throughout
near-zero in both halves of the suppressed arm while the control has them throughout
the seven arrive in both halves of the suppressed arm; addendum 52's result was chance

kill_criterion: near-zero arrivals of the seven while suppressed AND a clear return after restoration, in 2 of 2, with the control showing them in both halves, makes frequency the cavern lever
culling: drop a replicate on any changed save

arms.name: suppress_then_restore
pre: local sw=reqscript('seasonal-wildlife'); local cfg=sw.loadConfig(); if not cfg.initialized then sw.captureDefault(cfg) end; cfg.enabled=false; cfg.groups.enabled=false; cfg.ecology.enabled=false; sw.saveConfig(cfg); sw.disableSched(); print('tool disabled: this measures DF, not the roster')

local want={["CRUNDLE"]=1,["ELK_BIRD"]=1,["TROGLODYTE"]=1,["BIRD_SWALLOW_CAVE_GIANT"]=1,["CROCODILE_CAVE"]=1,["TOAD_GIANT_CAVE"]=1,["FLESH_BALL"]=1}; local n=0; for _,cr in ipairs(df.global.world.raws.creatures.all) do if want[cr.creature_id] then cr.frequency=0; n=n+1 end end; print(('e34 SUPPRESSED %d cavern species to frequency 0'):format(n))

local want={["CRUNDLE"]=1,["ELK_BIRD"]=1,["TROGLODYTE"]=1,["BIRD_SWALLOW_CAVE_GIANT"]=1,["CROCODILE_CAVE"]=1,["TOAD_GIANT_CAVE"]=1,["FLESH_BALL"]=1}; local ur=df.global.world.world_data.underground_regions; local function depth(cid) local r=ur[cid]; return r and r.layer_depth or -1 end; if df.global.cur_year_tick>=67200 then local r=0; for _,cr in ipairs(df.global.world.raws.creatures.all) do if want[cr.creature_id] and cr.frequency==0 then cr.frequency=100; r=r+1 end end; if r>0 then print(('e34 RESTORED %d species at tick %d'):format(r,df.global.cur_year_tick)) end end; local cav,deep,land=0,0,0; for _,u in ipairs(df.global.world.units.active) do if dfhack.units.isWildlife(u) and not dfhack.units.isDead(u) and not u.flags1.inactive then local r=u.animal.population; if r.cave_id>=0 then if depth(r.cave_id)<=2 then cav=cav+1 else deep=deep+1 end elseif r.feature_idx<0 then land=land+1 end end end; local sup=0; for _,cr in ipairs(df.global.world.raws.creatures.all) do if want[cr.creature_id] and cr.frequency==0 then sup=sup+1 end end; local cz=0; for _,u in ipairs(df.global.world.units.active) do if dfhack.units.isCitizen(u) and not dfhack.units.isDead(u) then cz=cz+1 end end; print(('e34: caverns=%d deep=%d land=%d citizens=%d suppressed=%d tick=%d day=%d'):format(cav,deep,land,cz,sup,df.global.cur_year_tick,math.floor(df.global.cur_year_tick/1200)))
